mapping_decisions.statement: Approve all eight recovered direct L03 bindings as the bounded source pool for later Vocabulary mapping, while preserving each existing FROZEN/WATCH/CANDIDATE authority label.
Approve all four semantic lanes as the bounded evidence-theme pool for later Teacher Notes mapping, without implying one-to-one lane-to-note assignment.
Preserve the Vocabulary target of 16 slots while recognizing that only eight source-backed bindings are currently recovered; the remaining lexical capacity stays unresolved and must not be invented.
Preserve the Teacher Notes target of 3 slots while treating the four semantic lanes as source evidence only; no Teacher Note content is authored under this gate.
Keep SARU as WATCH evidence for 'todos os dias / habitualidade' only; do not use this source-mapping gate to equate it with 'usually' or resolve the English target 'I usually...'.
Keep curriculum_slot_assignments at zero; this gate approves source eligibility only, not exact Vocabulary or Teacher Notes slot placement.

governance_decisions.statement: Source eligibility mapping is not authoring, validation, runtime activation, registry rebind application or language-authority promotion.
No locative, predicate, modal, habitual, frequency, aspect, tense, morphology, interrogative, declarative or word-order grammar may be inferred from Vocabulary/Teacher Notes source eligibility.
FROZEN/WATCH/CANDIDATE labels remain unchanged and curriculum relevance does not promote WATCH or CANDIDATE entries.
Reference languages may compare semantics only and numerology may preserve counts only; neither selects missing HNK lexemes, grammar or payloads.
No L01/L02 scoped grammar is inherited as universal or L03 grammar; source reuse remains lexical/semantic evidence only unless separately reviewed.
If approved, prepare a separate exact L03 Vocabulary source-to-slot mapping gate before any Vocabulary authoring; Teacher Notes exact mapping must also remain separately governed.
